issues.description: SealSaloon.orders is specified in the problem statement/UML as a modifiable List<Meal> (FIFO order queue), but the solution implements it as an array (private Meal[] orders). This creates a mismatch in the expected data structure and operations (List methods vs. array manipulation via ArrayHelpers).
issues.suggestedFix: Align specification and implementation: either change SealSaloon.orders in code to List<Meal> (e.g., ArrayList) and implement FIFO accordingly, or update the UML/problem statement to explicitly require Meal[] orders and array-based queue operations using ArrayHelpers.
